tools.name: add_reserved_ip
tools.description: Reserve one address inside an existing prefix.

tools.name: create_dns_zone
tools.description: Create a blank DNS zone for an apex domain. Use the returned id with upsert_dns_record. Does not import existing records. The zone stays pending until the registrar delegates the domain to the returned nameservers. Fails with already_exists if the domain is already hosted (use list_dns_zones) and wh

tools.name: create_network
tools.description: Create an IPAM network. This does not allocate addresses.

tools.name: create_plan
tools.description: Clone a template plan into one region on the given nodes. Prices, CPU limits, and credit policy stay on the template. Returns success only; call list_preflight_checks to find the new plan.

tools.name: create_prefix
tools.description: Create an IPAM prefix on an existing network. Gateway and reserved addresses must sit inside the CIDR.

tools.name: create_snapshot
tools.description: Create a snapshot of a virtual machine.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Create a support ticket.

tools.name: create_virtual_machine
tools.description: Create a virtual machine using SSH keys (no passwords).

tools.name: create_vm_template
tools.description: Record a VM template that already exists on a node. template_id is the hypervisor template id, not a value to invent. cloud_init_template_id must already exist.

tools.name: delete_virtual_machine
tools.description: Permanently delete a virtual machine. Removes the VM, its snapshots, and its backups, and releases its addresses. If this was the last VM on its subscription, that subscription is cancelled immediately and a final hourly usage charge is recorded. Call only when the user explicitly asked to delete th

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get a provider agent by UUID. Does not return peering configuration or error text.

tools.name: get_dashboard_summary
tools.description: Summarize the provider fleet: active VMs, customers, nodes, tickets, and region and plan breakdowns.

tools.name: get_dns_zone
tools.description: Get a DNS zone by UUID.

tools.name: get_firewall_ruleset
tools.description: Get a firewall rule set by UUID.

tools.name: get_identity
tools.description: Get the authenticated Noderings identity (service account).

tools.name: get_marketplace_plan
tools.description: Get a marketplace plan by UUID with the regions it can be deployed in (region_id values for create_virtual_machine).

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Get a provider node by UUID.

tools.name: get_node_placement_policy
tools.description: Get the node placement policy. Read this before update_node_placement_policy; that call replaces the whole policy.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get an organization by UUID.

tools.name: get_platform
tools.description: Get a platform by UUID. Includes driver, service status, and endpoint URL.

tools.name: get_prefix_utilization
tools.description: Get address utilization for one prefix.

tools.name: get_provider_customer
tools.description: Get one customer organization by UUID. Does not include payment details or billing amounts.

tools.name: get_provider_onboarding_checklist
tools.description: Get the provider onboarding checklist.

tools.name: get_region
tools.description: Get a region by UUID.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Get a support ticket by UUID.

tools.name: get_virtual_machine
tools.description: Get a virtual machine by UUID, including ipv4 and ipv6 when allocated. Does not return a guest login user or SSH key material.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List provider agents. Does not return peering configuration or install commands.

tools.name: list_backups
tools.description: List backups for a virtual machine.

tools.name: list_distros
tools.description: List guest operating systems. Use the distro value as create_virtual_machine.distro.

tools.name: list_dns_records
tools.description: List DNS records in a zone.

tools.name: list_dns_zones
tools.description: List DNS zones.

tools.name: list_firewall_rulesets
tools.description: List firewall rule sets.

tools.name: list_marketplace_offerings
tools.description: Search marketplace offerings with a natural-language query. Each result carries the plan_id (id) and region_id for create_virtual_machine.

tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: List IPAM networks.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: List provider nodes.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List organizations visible to the service account.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List Noderings subscription plans (billing tiers). Not the plan_id for create_virtual_machine; use list_marketplace_offerings for that. Not the plan_id for create_plan; use list_template_plans for that.

tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: List platforms.

tools.name: list_prefixes
tools.description: List IPAM prefixes for one network. Pass network_id from list_networks. An empty network_id returns a note to call list_networks first.

tools.name: list_preflight_checks
tools.description: List marketplace preflight status for provider plans.

tools.name: list_provider_customers
tools.description: List customer organizations that have purchased from this provider. Does not include payment details.

tools.name: list_provider_virtual_machines
tools.description: List guest virtual machines running on this provider. This is the provider view; it does not include MAC addresses.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List regions.

tools.name: list_snapshots
tools.description: List snapshots for a virtual machine.

tools.name: list_ssh_keys
tools.description: List SSH keys of the organization (UUID, name, fingerprint). Use the id values as create_virtual_machine.ssh_key_ids.

tools.name: list_template_plans
tools.description: List template plans a provider can clone. These are not subscription tiers. Pass code to narrow the list. Use an id from here as create_plan.plan_id. Prices are not returned.

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: List support tickets.

tools.name: list_virtual_machines
tools.description: List virtual machines. Each summary includes id, name, status, region, and ipv4/ipv6 when allocated.

tools.name: list_vm_templates
tools.description: List VM templates. template_id is the hypervisor template id already present on the node.

tools.name: remove_reserved_ip
tools.description: Remove one reserved address from a prefix.

tools.name: update_node_placement_policy
tools.description: Replace the node placement policy. Omitted region overrides are cleared. Read get_node_placement_policy first.

tools.name: update_virtual_machine_power
tools.description: Start, stop, or reboot a virtual machine.

tools.name: upsert_dns_record
tools.description: Create a DNS record. Overwrites an existing name+type only when allow_overwrite is true. Types: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_virtual_machine" references sensitive artifacts (ssh key, password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Create a virtual machine using SSH keys (no passwords).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_virtual_machine" references sensitive artifacts (ssh key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get a virtual machine by UUID, including ipv4 and ipv6 when allocated. Does not return a guest login user or SSH key material.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_ssh_keys" references sensitive artifacts (.ssh, ssh_key, ssh key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List SSH keys of the organization (UUID, name, fingerprint). Use the id values as create_virtual_machine.ssh_key_ids.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "list_template_plans" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
